Phone-filmed looking vertical video (not polished) with long-form story or hook text overlaid directly on the moving footage; feels organic rather than ad-like. 15-30s length for B2B SaaS.

if we apply this, CTR improves because X rewards native, authentic content that blends into the feed; viewers read the full story while motion keeps them engaged, avoiding ad blindness vs produced creatives.
Film casual phone footage of workflow or reaction; overlay readable text narrative on video itself; keep under 30s; pair with strong caption; test for timeline ads where it mimics organic posts.
